{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert the 'revenue' column to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check the new dtype of 'revenue'
revenue_dtype_after = sales_df['revenue'].dtype

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Calculate the mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue_completed = df_completed['revenue'].mean()

revenue_dtype_after, mean_revenue_completed"}
